INTRODUCTION: Hello. My name is_____________ and I am from the Population Council consulting, New Delhi.  With support from the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Mizoram, we are conducting a brief survey of nutrition and dietary diversity in your area to learn more about your food habits and diet. With your permission, I would like to invite you to participate in a study in which we are trying to understand your and your child’s food pattern, support of ICDS centre etc.  We will also measure your height and weight to understand your nutrition status. This survey will take around 20-30 minutes to complete. There are minimal risks or no risks in participating, and you may stop participating at any time during the interview. All of your responses will be kept confidential.
